PASSWORD_REQUIREMENTS:
Your password needs to contain the following elements:
  • Eight charachters
  • One letter
  • One number
ERROR_MAIL_SERVER_MESSAGE: Please check your details or try again later
EMAIL_SEND_MESSAGE: Verification Email sent. Please verify your email
REGISTER_SUCCESSFUL: We have sent you an email, please check your inbox
PASSWORD_SEND: Password send, please check your inbox
RESET_PASSWORD_HINT: To reset your password enter your email and we will send you a new password.
REGISTER_PAGE_HINT:
Welcome to Sammlr,

please type your name down below. This name is visible to stores when they scan your qr code.
REGISTER_SHOP_PAGE_HINT:
Welcome to Sammlr,

please provide some information about your store and choose a profile picture :)
REGISTER_FINAL_HINT: Now enter your e-mail and choose a password to become a member of Sammlr.
SEND_NOTIFICATION_TO_CUSTOMER: Send a notification to your customers
TITLE: Notification title
NO_CARDS_HINT: Sorry, but it seems like you dont have any cards by now. Go checkout new stores in your area and start to earn points.
CAMERA_OVER_QR_CODE: Hold the camera over the qr code of your customer
REDEEM_POINTS_HINT: You are about to redeem [POINTS] points.
TERMS_HINT: By creating an account you accept our
MISSING_FEATURE_TEXT: This feature is currently not available, please try again in a few days.
SHOPS_NEARBY_HINT: There are [number1] stores close to you, where you can collect points.
LOYALTY_CENTER_HINT: Here you can customize your card that appears in your customers collection, when they have collected at least one point of your store. You can set a custom image for your card, set the number of required points and add a description how to earn points in your store.
CHECKOUT_HINT: Choose a way to pay and complete the payment process of your selected provider. If you need help or have questions feel free to contact us.
GPS_ERROR_HINT: Please ensure that you have activated the location services of your mobile phone and that you have allowed the app to use them.
SCANNER_INIT_FAIL_HINT: Please make sure that your device has a camera and that it is enabled for the app.
NO_VALID_CODE_HINT: This code does not belong to sammlr
ERROR_SCANNER_INIT_HINT: We're sorry, but there was an error in the qr scanner.
SCANNER_PERMISSION_DENIED_HINT: Please allow the app to access your device's camera.
NO_SHOP_NEARBY_HINT: Send an invite to Sammlr and secure your first reward
COLLECT_POINTS_DESCRIPTION:
With Sammlr you can collect your loyalty cards with your smartphone. 
Just show your qr code to your favorite store.
ONBAORDING_REDEEM_POINTS_HINT: For a complete card you can redeem free gifts by the store. Just show your card  and redeem your bonus.
ONBOARDING_ALWAYS_WITH_YOU_HINT: You can no longer loose your cards in your pocket. You keep them always with you. They are stored in your account and also dont fade out.
ONBOARDING_NOTIFICATION_HINT: Let your favorite stores send you updates about special offers, sales or coupons. If you don't want to miss anything please allow us to send you push notifications.
INVITATION_SEND_HINT: The referral code was successfully sent to the Store
REFERRAL_HINT: You can send a referral code to an unregistered store. When your code is used to register a new store account, you will be credited with a full loyalty card of this store.
INVALID_REFERRAL_MESSAGE: The referral code you entered is not valid
DELETE_ACCOUNT_HINT:
Are you sure you want to delete your account?

Be aware, that this can not be undone, because your account data will be lost forever. If you are unhappy with Sammlr feel free to contact us.

Otherwise type your email and you are good to go.
ACCEPT_ACCOUNT_DELETE: I'm sure to delete my account forever.
WANT_GRANT_PERMISSION: If you want to grant permission for using your camera, enable it in the app settings.
NEED_PERMISSION: We need your permission to use your camera to be able to scan qr codes
CHOOSE_USER_HINT: Welcome to Sammlr, please choose which account you want to register. As a user you can collect points and redeem store specific rewards. As a store you can build your customer pool and use our functions to stay in contact with them.
ONBOARDING_CREDIT_POINTS_SHOP_HINT: With our built in qr scanner you can scan the qr codes of your customers and credit them points. By the first point you credit a customer, your loyalty card is added to the customers collection
ONBOARDING_GET_FOUND_SHOP_HINT: To make you visible to new customers, customers see you within a radius of 5 km. So make sure you have a fancy profile picture :-)
ONBOARDING_LOYALTY_CARD_SHOP_HINT: The loyalty card is the way to connect your customers with your store. Feel free to customize your loyalty card to your liking. Change the picture, number of points and explain your card conditions.
ONBOARDING_NOTIFICATIONS_SHOP_HINT: Send messages to your customer base. Your customer base consists of all customers who ever collected points from you.
ONBOARDING_REDEEM_POINTS_SHOP_HINT: After you have credited a customer as many points as your loyalty card can fit, you can scan the qr code on your customers loyalty card to redeem the card.
ONBOARDING_STORE_WINDOW_SHOP_HINT: In your virtual shop window you can show customers what they can expect from you.
WHO_ARE_YOU_HINT_ONBOARDING: Welcome to Sammlr, if you want to know what functions sammlr has, then choose one of the following two options.
ONBAORDING_HOW_IT_WORKS_TITLE: Show your qr code to earn points
ONBOARDING_HOW_IT_WORKS_TEXT: Earn points by showing your qr code to participating stores
ADD_OFFER_DESCRIPTION: Add pictures of your best products to show your customers what to expect, when they visit your store.
ASK_FOR_PUSH_MESSAGE: Do you want to receive great offers from your favorite stores?
TRANSACTION_MAIL_SENT: The transactions will be sent to your mail within the next minutes.
NO_NEWS_HINT: None of your stores has a current news. Check out again next time.
ENABLE_DEBUG_MESSAGE: Debug Mode is for testing only. Any of your actions will be deleted after a certain time.
ERROR_INVALID_TOKEN: Attention: This is not your card
NO_NEARBY_NEWS_HINT: Activate GPS to display news from your local area.
SCAN_YOUR_CARD: Scann the qr code from your Sammlr-Card
CARD_ALREADY_REGISTERD: This card is already linked to another sammlr account.
MORE_ADDRESSES_HINT: Note: You can add more addresses to your store after registration.
WHERE_ARE_MY_ADDRESSES:
You can now add multiple addresses to your store. 
To do this, simply open the settings of the app.
LAST_ADDRESS_NOTIFICATION_MESSAGE: The last address in your store cannot be deleted.
ADDRESS_HINT_TEXT: A address represents a physical address where customers can find or reach your store.
YOUR_STORE_HINT:
Here you will find all the settings to present yourself to your customers. 
Enter information about your store, configure your loyalty program or manage your addresses.
CUSTOMER_CENTER_HINT: Here you will find a transaction overview of distributed and redeemed points, you can view your customer base or send offers to your customers' news feed.
NOTIFICATION_PERMISSION_CHANGE_MEMBERSHI: Sending messages is not possible with your current membership. Do you want to change your current membership?
INSTAGRAM_IMPORTER_DESCRIPTION: Activate the Instagram importer so that from now on your Instagram posts will also be posted to Sammlr. You can continue to post additional messages to Sammlr.
YOUR_PAYMENT_DESCRIPTION: The subscription will be debited monthly via your chosen payment method and can be canceled monthly.
ADDRESS_PERMISSION_CHANGE_MEMBERSHIP_HIN:
This feature is not included in your current membership. 
Would you like to change your membership?
CANCEL_MEMBERSHIP_ALERT_TITLE: Do you want so cancel your membership?
CANCEL_MEMBERSHIP_ALERT_HINT: If you cancel your membership, you will lose access to the features once your already paid month ends.
CANCEL_MEMBERSHIP_SUCCESS_HINT:
Your membership expires after the paid month. 
Until then, you can continue to use the premium functions.
LOGOUT_AFTER_PASSWORD_CHANGE: Attention: After changing your password you will be logged out
NFC_CARD_HINT:
Connect NFC cards to your loyalty program to be able to distribute points without a smartphone. 
If you need a Sammlr-NFC-Card you can find them in our online shop.
CONNECT_NFC_HINT: Hold your phone to the NFC card you want to connect.
SAVE_NFC_CARD_HINT: To link NFC cards, you must first save the loyalty card.
ERROCARD_ALREADY_EXISTS_HINT:
The NFC card is already connected to a loyalty card. 
Disconnect first.
LOYALTY_CENTER_NO_IMAGE_ERROR: Add a picture to your loyalty card.
SHOW_YOUR_QR_TO_REDEEM_CARD: Show the QR code or NFC scanner at a store to redeem the card
COLLECT_POINTS_NOW_HINT: Simply show your QR code at participating stores or activate NFC mode.
ACTIVATE_LOYALTY_CARD_ALERT_HINT: Do you want to activate the loyalty card?
DELETE_LOYALTY_CARD_HINT: If you delete this loyalty card, the card and already collected points will be removed from your customers.
PUSH_CENTER_HINT:
Inform your customers about news and offers via push notification. 
You can also reach new customers via our news feed in the app. 
However, keep in mind that only the latest message is displayed in the app.
NOTIFICATIONS_HINT:
As soon as you have sent messages to your customers, your sent messages will be displayed here. 
You will also receive data on the number of deliveries and openings
ENTER_NFC_DATA_HINT:
Give the NFC card a name and write it on the NFC card so you can identify it later. 
You can also set how many points the NFC card awards.
ONBOARDING_NFC_CARD_FUNCTIONALITY_HINT: After you have created your loyalty card, you can link it with nfc-cards, so you dont need to use your smartphone all the time you want to credit or redeem points. This is an even faster way to interact with your customers.
NFC_DEACTIVATED_HINT: To use the NFC-Mode, please activate nfc in your device settings
REDEEM_NOT_POSSIBLE_HINT: Make sure to have a full bonus card before you redeem
NFC_REDEEM_POINTS_HINT: Touch your phone to the store's NFC card to redeem points.
NFC_COLLECT_POINTS_HINT: Hold your phone up to the store's NFC card to collect points.
NFC_INSTRUCTION_HINT: Select 'Redeem' or 'Collect' to start NFC mode.
GENERIC_ERROR_HINT:
A problem occured. 
Please try again or contact Sammlr Support.
